source.name: MLB.com: Angels partnering with FBM on jersey patch (via Wayback Machine)
source.quote: the Angels announced Saturday that they entered a three-year agreement with Foundation Building Materials as their official jersey patch partner
source.note: Live page blocks scripts; checked via the Wayback capture of 5 April 2024. FBM was still the Angels' patch sponsor in 2026 (Blinkfire Analytics, 2026-04-20).

note: Jersey patch. Three-year agreement announced 2023-02-04, beginning with the 2023 season.
